36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
126818: Laios is the leader of his party and Falin's older brother. He is a tall-man from the Northern Continent. Laios is a monster fanatic and a strong fighter. His deep knowledge and passion for monsters helps him to excel in combat and dungeon exploration.
127292: Marcille is a mage who is part of Laios' party. She is an elf from the Northern Continent. Marcille is kind, intelligent, principled, and loyal to her friends.
127689: Senshi is a member of Laios' party. He is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent. Having spent 10 years studying monster cuisine and living a self-sufficient life inside the dungeon, Senshi loves cooking and is more than happy to share his knowledge and skills.
130506: Shuro is a former member of the Thorden siblings' party. His real name is Toshiro Nakamoto. He is an Eastern man with long black hair tied back in a ponytail, fair skin, and black eyes. He is shorter than Laios but taller than Marcille.
130507: Izutsumi is a former member of Shuro's party and currently a part of Laios' party. She is a tall-man (beast-man) from the Eastern Archipelago.
130508: Falin is Laios's younger sister and a mage specializing in support spells. She is a tall-man from the Northern Continent. Falin is a very kind, caring, and considerate person who doesn't want to hurt others.
130509: Chilchuck is a member of Laios' party. He is a half-foot from the Eastern Continent. Chilchuck is shrewd, practical, and sharp-tongued. He refuses to take jobs unless he is paid in advance. His specialties are lockpicking and identifying and disarming traps.
135286: Kabru is the leader of his party, exploring the dungeon together with Rinsha, Mickbell, Kuro, Daia, and Holm. He is a tall-man from Utaya, part of the Western Continent.
135288: Thistle is the mage responsible for the creation of the dungeon on The Island and a jester who served in the court of King Delgal during the Golden Age. His actions make him the primary antagonist of the manga Delicious in Dungeon.
135289: She's a young wizard from the Eastern countries and a member of Kabru's party. It is hinted that she might have romantic feelings towards Kabru as she seems extremely jealous over him.
135290: Namari is a former member of Laios' party and a current member of Tansu's party. She is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent. Namari is very knowledgeable about weapons and blacksmithing.
149833: Mithrun is the captain of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. He was born to a noble family, the House of Kerensil, and has one older brother. He is a male elf who is the head of the group. He has pale hair cut in a short bob.
149834: Inutade is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers. She is an ogre from the Eastern Archipelago. Compared to her comrades in Shuro's group, Tade is carefree, friendly, rather simple-minded, and gets hungry easily. Her real name is Hijouhi (ヒジョウヒ).
149835: Maizuru is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers. She is a tall-man from the Eastern Archipelago. Her real name is Iyo (イヨ). Having known him his whole life, Maizuru is a brilliant yet overprotective teacher to Shuro.
149836: Member of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. She is the second child of a noble family, the House of Vari, and was appointed by her parents to join the Canaries.
149837: Otta is the smallest member of Captain Mithrun's squad. Otta's magic involves the manipulation of earth and stone to make platforms and walls within the dungeon.
149838: Member of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. She appears to be second in command to Misurn. Her magic specialty is unknown, but she offers to 'burn' an enemy at one point, and seems to use a tool that looks like a branch of lily of the valley flowers.
239685: Mr. Floke is a gnomish mage dispatched by the powers residing in Kahka Brud to investigate the dungeon. Thoughtful and overflowing with wisdom, he serves as advisor to the governor.
239686: A researcher of ancient elemental spirit magic who belongs to Kabru's party. This researcher of ancient elemental spirit magic makes use of 4 different spirits.
239687: A kobold who joined Kabru's party alongside Mickbell. This loyal kobold never wavers in his dedication to his master.
239688: Kiki is of the twins in Tansu's party. She is a tall-man. Kiki and her twin brother Kaka were born into a nomadic clan, but one day they were left behind at a tavern as children, and were sleeping in a stable when Mr. and Mrs. Tansu found and adopted them.
239689: Benichidori is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers, and is a member of the ninja squad who serves the Nakamoto clan. She is a tall-man from the Eastern Archipelago. Her real name is Matsu (マツ).
239690: A half-foot member of Kabru's party. Wherever he goes, this stingy half-foot is always with Kuro!
239691: A dwarven woman, just like Namari. This powerful dwarven lady uses her axe to mow down monsters!
239693: Kaka is of the twins in Tansu's party. He is a tall-man. Kaka and his twin sister Kiki were born into a nomadic clan, but one day they were left behind at a tavern as children, and were sleeping in a stable when Mr. and Mrs. Tansu found and adopted them.
239694: Mrs. Floke is a gnomish mage dispatched by the powers residing in Kahka Brud to investigate the dungeon. Thoughtful and overflowing with wisdom, she serves as advisor to the governor.
239695: Hien is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers, and is a member of the ninja squad who serves the Nakamoto clan. She is a tall-man from the Eastern Archipelago. Her real name is Naka (ナカ).
248270: Fleki has wavy, shoulder-length hair and messy bangs, as well as notches in both of her ears like the other Canaries indicating conviction of having used black magic.
248271: Lycion is a member of Mithrun's squad of Canaries. He is an aloof, laid-back elf. Like many of the other Canaries, he has notches cut into his ears, a mark of being convicted of using black magic.
323626: Doni is a novice adventurer currently exploring the dungeon with Fionil. He is a tall-man from the Northern Continent. Doni's parents are farmers, but he dreamed of seeing the world, so he left home and traveled to the Island to pursue his dreams of exploration.
323629: Fionil is a novice adventurer currently exploring the dungeon with Doni. She is a half-elf from the Northern Central Continent. Fionil was originally hired by the western elves to report any changes that occurred on the island due to the dungeon.
324194: Half-foot that belongs to Chilchuck Tims' half-foot guild. When Laios was searching for a half-foot party member to travel into the deeper levels of the dungeon, Dandan introduced Chilchuck to Laios' Party.
324922: A Living Armor mollusk monster who lives in the handle of Laios's sword. The only visible parts of Kensuke appear to be antenna-like eyes, which poke out of the hilt of the sword it inhabits.
324941: Chieftain of the orcs in the dungeon on the Island.
325866: An adventurer who talks to Kabru and his party in episode 5.
